numa_local_control.procedure: Local CPU affinity from startup using taskset; confirmed large host mappings local to GPUs. Same four-warmup benchmark, after excluded C32 prime. Three serial repeats per concurrency.

raw_copy_microbenchmark.procedure: Single H200, local pinned host memory. Exact data check for every case; median of five 100-copy loops. Repeated sources, no L2 flush. This is not a serving comparison.
raw_copy_microbenchmark.decision: Do not retain: mapped-host fused kernel was slower than existing copies for full tails. C++ loop reduced CPU launch work but not transfer time.
raw_copy_microbenchmark.excluded: Prototype CUDA batched copy returned invalid argument.

cold_diagnostics.procedure: 128 random 2048-input/512-output requests at C32, zero warmups, cache flushed before every run, separate excluded prime, serial rotated repeats. Same retained-code and flag-off controls.
cold_diagnostics.decision: Omitting duplicate rows recovered only about 0.8% serving throughput; no shared host-chunk protocol retained. Combined no-decode-capture/no-D2H remains below flag off and changes donation work.

earlier_payload_omission.warning: Diagnostic only; H2D forbidden. Raw-only diagnostic had remote host pools on one TP rank, so it does not isolate a clean raw-copy cost.

fitting_long_decode.exclude: Iteration 0 included shape warmup on each server; only iteration 1 is a primed pair, not a repeated qualified result.

capacity_limited_long_decode.exclude: Different admission and acceptance behavior; exceeds enabled Full cap with all 32 active. Excluded from steady-decode cost attribution.

admission_correction.description: Bounded recurrent states have zero incremental Full-token cost. Planner independently counts/gates/debits state slots, including host restores. Shared-budget allocators retain their original token charge.

negative_control.result: Both zero-cost planner regression tests fail against pre-correction code.

admission_correction.minimization: One zero-cost override plus explicit slot-count accounting in the existing planner; private helper and callers renamed for units. No new public option, dependency, or kernel.
admission_correction.run_order: Enabled repeats first, followed by a freshly restarted flag-off control using the same planner code, then enabled spot checks. All measurements serial; no active tests, startup, or profiler during timing.

direct_capture_experiments.description: Write accepted decode features directly to owned chunks, with CPU metadata consumption only committing chunk lengths. Second prototype caches unchanged destination tables.
direct_capture_experiments.run_order: An excluded priming run, then two serial repetitions of C1 and C32, reversing variant order in the second repetition. Local CPU affinity. No active tests, startup, or profiler during timing.

direct_capture_experiments.placement_caveat: Direct used GPUs 4/5; cached-direct used GPUs 0/1. Retained used 2/3 and flag off 6/7. Separate series are not a same-placement comparison of the descriptor-cache change.
direct_capture_experiments.memory_caveat: Ahead-of-commit destination chunks can outlive an active owner through queued captures. Existing packed-capture staging bound has not been proved for this protocol; serving correctness alone does not establish that bound.
direct_capture_experiments.microbenchmark_caveat: Mapped pinned descriptors were kept alive until device synchronization. GPU-event intervals in this launch loop include host submission gaps; these are not pure device kernel timings. This variant was not integrated into serving.

warmed_profiles.procedure: Each server ran two full C32 warmups and one C1 warmup before capture; each capture flushed the radix cache and used zero benchmark warmup requests. Serial captures with local CPU affinity. Nsight Systems 2026.3.2, CUDA/NVTX/OS runtime, graph-level tracing.

enabled_c32.caveats: GPU busy includes collective waits; CPU intervals and correlated GPU duration sums overlap. Span ends at the final forward CPU return and can omit its queued device tail. Profiles diagnose behavior and are not unprofiled throughput measurements.

warmed_profiles.limitations: Transfer overlap is correlated with slower target graphs, not proven causal: sequence positions, checkpoint tracking and batch composition vary. C1 profiler overhead amplifies the gap. GPU busy includes collective waits. Use unprofiled comparisons for throughput claims.

serialized_backups.description: At cache construction, bind the raw-tail engine to the controller D2H stream. Keep H2D independent. No added buffers, checkpoint protocol or runtime option.
serialized_backups.run_order: Fresh enabled server; full serving correctness, excluded C32 prime, then three repetitions of C1 and C32. Enabled/off in the first repetition, off/enabled in the next two. Serial; no active tests, startup or profiler during timing.
serialized_backups.off_source_note: The disabled process predates the final flag-gated stream binding; its executed flag-off path is unchanged. Its builder source before this change is archived separately because older snapshots symlinked this file.
serialized_backups.minimization: Keep a local reference to the raw engine during construction; bind its existing public stream after the controller exists. No private pool access, new setter, pool or buffering protocol.

post_serialization_transfer_diagnostics.description: Temporary invalid-recovery diagnostics on serialized production; omission occurs after preparing indices and events, preserves capture/ownership, H2D raises. Cold cache, zero benchmark warmups, one C32 priming run excluded, two serial reversed-order repetitions, local CPU affinity. Diagnostic first C1 pass may include remaining shape warmup. C1 controls are on different GPU pairs; tiny differences are not causal attribution. No production change.

mamba_copy_engine_experiment.status: Not retained; roughly 0.15% C32 improvement and slight C1 regression across different GPU pairs do not justify generic staging machinery.
mamba_copy_engine_experiment.implementation: Temporary Triton gather of one checkpoint into GPU scratch, followed by copy-engine D2H; source slot remains GPU-indexed, destination slot comes from existing CPU metadata. One checkpoint scratch per state tensor on the transfer stream, reused by the CUDA caching allocator.

microbenchmark.note: Device event intervals include submission gaps; exact payload/neighbor checks pass. One reusable checkpoint staging buffer; no inference overlap.

mamba_copy_engine_experiment.caveats: Same benchmark as main results, two repeats after excluded C32+C1 priming; candidate GPUs0/1, retained GPUs4/5, off6/7, all local CPU affinity. No concurrent startup, tests or profiler. Small differences can reflect placement.

held_draft_bindings_experiment.status: Rejected; no throughput improvement. Production still frees draft bindings when Full pages are freed.
held_draft_bindings_experiment.description: Temporary bounded-allocator overrides release only Full pages, holding draft bindings for reuse by the existing window kernel. No separate pool or extra capacity. Would need a full stale-virtual-ID/lifetime audit before production.
held_draft_bindings_experiment.procedure: Prototype GPU2/3 and fresh same-source control GPU0/1 share local CPU affinity0-47; off6/7 local48-95. ExcludedC32+C1 prime pernewserver; two reversed repeats at eachconcurrency, four benchmarkwarmups. All timings serial with no profiler, startup or tests.

post_serialization_full_transfer_diagnos.description: Invalid-recovery diagnostics on current serialized production: omit target-Full payloads only, or all D2H payloads. Capture/ownership, index preparation, events and bookkeeping remain; all H2D raises. Both ranks logged the omitted classes. Two reversed-order serial C32 repeats after an excluded prime, cache flush, zero benchmark warmups. All expected token counts and equal acceptance.
post_serialization_full_transfer_diagnos.caveats: Different GPU pairs: Full2/3, all4/5, control0/1, off6/7; all local CPU affinity. Earlier same-source runs show small placement variation. Do not add individual omissions or interpret all-copy removal as a valid implementation.

compute_stream_priority_experiment.description: Temporary constructor-only experiment: DFlash forward streams at CUDA priority -1, backups unchanged at priority 0. Exact current-source control. Full TP2 recovery/branching passed before benchmarks. Two reversed-order serial repeats after excluded C32/C1 primes, four warmup requests, cache flush, fixed 2048/512 lengths. Candidate GPUs2/3, enabled control0/1, off6/7; each locally CPU-affined. Different GPU pairs limit sub-percent attribution. No production edits or new buffers.
compute_stream_priority_experiment.decision: Not retained: C1 is unchanged/slightly lower and the C32 gain is only 0.13%, comparable to placement variation; no established improvement sufficient to change stream policy.

post_serialization_profiles.description: Current retained production after admission correction and shared D2H stream. Fresh enabled GPUs4/5 and off GPUs2/3, each CPU-affined locally. Two complete C32 primes and one C1 prime, then flushed zero-warmup C32/C1 full-workload Nsight captures. Both processes stopped before offline analysis. Graph-level CUDA/NVTX/OSRT tracing; no sampling. Profile durations are diagnostic, not throughput results.

raw_append_sm_copy_experiment.description: Temporary immediate accepted-row append using torch._foreach_copy_ with one destination/source instead of Tensor.copy_. No batching, deferred donation, new buffers, or ownership changes. Standalone profiler confirms multi_tensor_apply kernel and no memcpy. Full TP2 pressure/recovery/branching passed.
